body:
I have been very open with the trying of new things. My friends are also very much like I am, so we usually try these new things together. One day, my buddy invited me over to hangout. When I arrived, he produced a phat gram. We proceeded to do a constant supply from 9pm to 3am, when we cut ourselves off. We spent the rest of the day talkin and playing some games, which we did very well at because out hightened concentration and reaction time. Once that night rolled around, we decided what the hell, we might as well have another session. This session I cannot remember specific times, but we went much harder.
Once we did this, we played more video games and talked yet some more. We were in an almost euphoric state, absolutely nothing could bring us down and put us in a mood. Once the middle-morning rolled around, I figured I should eat something. Although eating in this condition was a bad experience, I knew it must be done. After eating, we decided to take a couple phat rails. Each was equal to around 1/4 of a point, not a addict dose, but large enough. We were so tweaker until that night, and we did the rails at around 3am. Once we totally came down, it was not a good feeling. Our bodies were so pounded from no sleep and very very little food, all we wanted was quiet and laziness. AFter I woke up, I did not have a NEED for it, but I would not turn down a rail at this point.
This drug is very addictive
, but in my experience, I have had many a fun times while on this drug.
